global_history: When the sky-ships fell through the veil of Aether, they didn't land on dirt, but on the memories of a dreaming god. The survivors found a realm where silicon pulsed with mana and steel bled starlight. For centuries, the Exiles fought the shifting flora that mimicked their lost circuitry. Now, the Great Spire stands as a monument to their defiance, bridging the gap between old logic and new enchantments. They call it the New World—a cradle born from the wreckage of a billion stars, waiting for a heart to beat.

civilizations.name: The Iron-Bound Hegemony
civilizations.summary: A civilization rooted in physical dominance and the mastery of industrial metallurgy, where the strong lead and the weak are tempered into tools through grueling labor and martial discipline.

civilizations.name: The Flicker-Hand Hegemony
civilizations.summary: A civilization defined by extreme manual dexterity and lightning-fast reflexes, dwelling within a world of oscillating platforms and micro-mechanical wonders. Their culture rewards precision above all else, viewing stillness as a form of spiritual and physical decay.

taboos: Remaining Motionless for over One Minute
The Use of Automation that Replaces Manual Skill
conflict: The Rise of the Slow-Movement Cults

civilizations.name: The Cerebro-Synthetic Collective of Aethelgard
civilizations.summary: A civilization defined by the pursuit of pure intellect, where biological brains are integrated into a vast, silicon-based planetary network to optimize efficiency and knowledge acquisition.
